entries.text: Idea: i think i will name the landing struts the gavin-legs and try to build them from recycled hangar tension springs.
Read "Naming the M113 after General James M. Gavin to honor the great human being who created it": General Gavin knew that light, mobile armor could change the whole game for paratroopers.
pacing around the comms tower with my dish pointed skyward, scanning the digital airwaves for structural secrets
entries.why: my hull needs to be tougher for the high altitudes, and the Wire always has clever tricks for scrap-metal builders like me.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "still tinkering under the stars"
